transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I just... I feel like I can't settle. In my own body, I mean. It's getting harder to just sit quietly, especially when I'm supposed to be doing paperwork or figuring out household stuff.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and won't go away?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I have anything like that. Just the usual stuff, I guess.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or moving around more than you used to?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... like at church meetings, or even just family dinners. I'm usually... I don't know, twisting my wedding ring around, or bouncing my foot. I try to sit still and look put together, but I just end up shifting around in my chair a lot.
Do you feel like you have to perform certain actions over and over?
No... I don't think so. I don't feel forced to do anything like that. Just... no.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Um, no. I don't think so. I usually try to think about things before I do them... so, no, not really.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I guess I worry about normal things sometimes, but... no, I wouldn't say I'm an anxious person. Just normal, I think.
Do you feel like your fidgeting or moving around helps you feel better or calmer?
I don't know... I haven't really noticed. I don't think it's about feeling calm or anything. I just... move sometimes, I guess. Not really for any specific reason.
Did you have trouble sitting still when you were a kid?

I mean... I guess so. Um, looking back, I think it was always there, even in elementary school. I was always the one with the messy desk, or I'd forget my permission slips. And... yeah, teachers would write notes saying I talked out of turn, or that I couldn't stay in my seat. So... yes, I suppose I did.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

I guess so. Um... sometimes. Like, if I'm putting together a volunteer sign-up sheet, or... doing our household budget. I'll realize later that I entered the wrong date, or... skipped a line. Sometimes I reverse numbers, even though I thought I had already checked it. So... yeah, that happens.
Are your difficulties with sitting still, paying attention to details, or making careless mistakes causing problems for you at work or in your relationships?

I guess so. Um... mostly just that... people at home, or in my volunteer groups... they can't really count on me. I try hard to keep up, but... things still fall through. So... I've had to step back from some of my responsibilities lately. I just... yeah, it causes some issues.
Do you often do things that might be considered reckless or impulsive, such as speeding or spending too much money?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think I do things like that. I drive fine, and... I don't really spend that much. So... no.
Did you have trouble paying attention or following instructions when you were a kid?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in elementary school. I... I was always the girl with the really messy desk. And... I'd forget permission slips a lot. My parents used to get notes from my teachers... saying I talked out of turn, or... that I couldn't seem to stay in my seat. So... yeah, I guess it was always a part of me.
Have you experienced these difficulties with sitting still and paying attention consistently throughout your childhood and into adulthood?
Um... yeah. I guess so. It hasn't really changed much. Just... always been this way, I suppose.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things around you?

Um... yeah, I guess I do. It doesn't take much. Like, if I'm... if I'm trying to do something at the kitchen table, just... a phone buzzing, or a car going by outside. Even just thinking about what to make for dinner. It just pulls me completely off track, and... I don't even realize I've stopped what I was supposed to be doing until later. So... yeah.
Have your difficulties with sitting still, paying attention, or making careless mistakes caused significant problems in your relationships or at work?

Um... yeah. I suppose it has. I don't work right now, but... at home, and... in the groups I volunteer with, I guess. It's just... people can't really count on me. I've actually had to... step back from some of my responsibilities lately. Just because I keep letting things fall through. Even when I'm really trying. So... yeah.
Have you had difficulty keeping jobs or maintaining relationships due to your symptoms?
Um... I don't know about jobs. I haven't worked in a while. And... relationships? I mean, I guess it's hard sometimes, but... I don't really know if it's because of that. It's just... hard to say.
Have you ever had to significantly change your role or responsibilities at work or in other activities because of your difficulties with sitting still, paying attention, or making careless mistakes?

Um... I think I just mentioned this, but... yeah. I've had to step back from some of the volunteer stuff I do. It's just... I keep letting things fall through, even when I try not to. So... people can't really count on me. I just... I had to change what I was doing because of it.
Have you experienced difficulties due to your symptoms in multiple areas of your life, such as at home and in your volunteer work?

Um... yes. Like I just said... it's both. At home and in my volunteer circles. The fallout is just... people can't really count on me. I keep letting things fall through, even though I really try not to. So... I've had to step back from responsibilities. In both areas, I guess.
Do you often feel restless or have an inability to engage in activities quietly in your daily life?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Even if I just want to have a quiet evening... like, sitting and reading next to my husband... it doesn't really work out. I just... I end up humming, or talking, or getting up to do little things. I just make too much noise, and then... it's not really peaceful anymore. So... yeah.
Have your symptoms caused problems in your relationships with friends or family members?

Um... I don't know. I mean... I guess my husband gets annoyed when I can't just sit quietly with him. But... I don't think it's caused any big problems. Just... normal stuff, I guess. I haven't really thought about it.
